title: quadlet: add podman quadlet exists command
body:
Adds a `podman quadlet exists QUADLET` command. It checks whether a quadlet is installed and sets the exit code so it can be used in shell scripts:

- `0` if the quadlet is found
- `1` if it is not found
- `125` on other errors, for example an unsupported extension like `foo.txt`

The full file name, including the extension, is required. `myapp` without `.container` is treated as an error, the same way `quadlet print` and `quadlet rm` already handle it.

Most of the code was already there. `QuadletExists` exists in the engine interface and the local (abi) implementation, and the REST endpoint `GET /libpod/quadlets/{name}/exists` was added earlier. This PR only adds the CLI command in `cmd/podman/quadlet/exists.go`, which follows the same pattern as `podman secret exists`. The remote (tunnel) implementation is unchanged, because the quadlet remote commands are not implemented yet and the system tests skip remote.

Also included:
- A man page, `podman-quadlet-exists.1.md`, and an entry in `podman-quadlet.1.md`.
- A system test in `test/system/253-podman-quadlet.bats`, "quadlet verb - exists". It checks exit 1 before install, exit 0 after install, exit 125 for an unsupported extension, and exit 1 again after `quadlet rm`.

Testing:
- `make binaries` builds `podman`, `podman-remote`, and `quadlet`.
- The new BATS test passes locally. The other quadlet verb tests pass except "install, list, print, rm - template". That test also fails on a clean `main` checkout on my machine, with the same `permission denied` error for `/var/lib/containers/storage`, so it looks like a local environment issue and not something this PR changes.
- Lint (`golangci-lint`) reports 0 issues for all build-tag combinations in `validatepr`.
- pre-commit, shfmt, swagger and xref checks pass.
- `make man-page-check` and `make validate.completions` pass on the host.

The `validatepr` container image does not include `libgpgme`, so the man page check fails inside the container. I ran that check on the host instead, where it passes.

Fixes: #30209

Release note:
Added `podman quadlet exists` to check whether a quadlet is installed.
